findings.motion: Second Reading, HB 958 Election Law Changes (Senate committee substitute), roll call 693, passed 28-13
findings.note: Senate roll call lists Ford among the ayes. The bill digest says the bill requires a covered military or overseas voter to send a photo ID copy with the ballot, requires voters to affirmatively state US citizenship (under penalty of perjury if they left the question blank) before a registration is processed, requires a full Social Security number to register, adds a challenge and audit process for ineligible votes, and gives voters five business days to cure missing ID after a provisional ballot. The page's history shows the bill was ratified 2026-08-06 and vetoed by the Governor 2026-08-17. The Senate third reading shows no recorded vote.
